name: Baseten
summary: Baseten is an inference platform for running models in production. It offers per-token Model APIs for popular open models, dedicated GPU deployments for your own models billed by the minute, and on-demand training compute. Enterprise customers can run it in Baseten's cloud, their own VPC or a hybrid setup.
facts: Per 1M tokens for Model APIs; per-minute GPU billing (H100 $0.108/min, B200 $0.166/min)
Baseten Cloud, self-hosted in your VPC, or hybrid (Enterprise)
SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA on all plans
Basic pay-as-you-go, Pro and Enterprise by quote
goodFor: Serving custom or fine-tuned models on dedicated GPUs
Teams needing VPC or hybrid deployment
watchOut: Autoscaling and priority GPU access are Pro-tier features
Dedicated GPUs cost money while scaled up
